intro: Cubed sofabed transforms from a cozy chair into a soft bed in seconds. Compact, stylish, and comfortable, it makes your small space feel bigger and your everyday moments effortless.

features.title: Transforms from sofa to bed with ease
features.text: Switch from stylish sofa to comfortable bed in one smooth motion, perfect for relaxing evenings or accommodating overnight guests.

features.title: Cushioned cubes for all-day comfort
features.text: Plush cube-like cushioning supports you while sitting or sleeping, keeping every moment cozy and relaxing.

features.title: Compact design for small spaces
features.text: Its space-saving form makes it ideal for apartments, studies, or guest rooms, giving you more function in less space.

features.title: Durable fabric that lasts long
features.text: Camel fabric upholstery withstands everyday use, staying soft, easy to clean, and reliable for years to come.

features.title: Camel tone that warms interiors
features.text: The earthy camel shade blends with wood and neutrals, creating a warm, welcoming look for any room.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
